verdict.rationale: Shopify's UCP Global and Storefront Catalog MCP servers return structured product data. Documented fields include multi-merchant offers clustered by UPID, price in minor units, variants with availability signals via get_product, and per-merchant price ranges and variants. Carts and checkouts return a continue_url checkout link. A runtime probe confirmed a live catalog search returning a variant ID, and a live cart created from it. Missing for 10: checkout links appear only after cart creation rather than in the offer payload; no coverage for services as opposed to products; access is gated on a hosted agent profile; no hands-on capture of a full offer payload showing price and availability fields.
